description: This file defines the CanvasManager class responsible for managing the canvas window and interactions within the OpenClaw macOS app. It includes methods for showing, hiding, and navigating the canvas, handling gateway updates, and managing canvas URLs and file paths.

classes.name: CanvasManager
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for managing the canvas window, including display, navigation, auto-navigation based on gateway updates, and debug status updates.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the canvas for a given session, optionally navigating to a specified path and placement.

methods.name: showDetailed
methods.description: Shows the canvas with detailed control, can reuse existing sessions or create new ones, and handles navigation to specific targets.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the canvas for a specific session.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code in the context of the current canvas session.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the current canvas view and saves it to a file.

methods.name: startGatewayObserver
methods.description: Starts observing the gateway connection for updates related to the canvas host URL.

methods.name: handleGatewayPush
methods.description: Handles incoming gateway updates, particularly canvas host URL snapshots, and performs auto-navigation if applicable.

methods.name: maybeAutoNavigateToA2UIAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously determines whether to auto-navigate to the A2UI URL based on gateway info.

methods.name: maybeAutoNavigateToA2UI
methods.description: Performs auto-navigation to the A2UI URL if conditions are met.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostUrl
methods.description: Resolves the full A2UI host URL from raw gateway data.

methods.name: refreshDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates the debug status UI elements based on app state.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostUrl
methods.description: Static method that constructs the A2UI URL from raw input.

methods.name: directURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL object from a target string, handling schemes and file paths.

methods.name: makeShowResult
methods.description: Creates a CanvasShowResult object indicating the status of showing a canvas.

methods.name: localStatus
methods.description: Determines whether a local directory has a valid index or is ready to serve.

methods.name: indexExists
methods.description: Checks if index.html or index.htm exists in a given directory.
